name: panda_pick_and_place_mjwarp_dense_v0_wall_clock
description: MuJoCo/MJWarp Menagerie Panda pick-and-place benchmark with a fixed wall-clock training window.
notes: Use on an NVIDIA/CUDA host with mujoco_warp installed; pass --train-seconds for longer remote runs.
The normal Gymnasium eval path stays CPU MuJoCo for deterministic parity while training collection can use the MJWarp vector backend.
Fixed eval success requires lift-before-place, so sliding the cube to the target does not solve the task.
